method: ENGINEERING fixed entrance view: all actors removed, encounters suppressed, invulnerability and no bob/recoil. Pixel masks measure viewmodel occlusion only; they do not establish visible-target acquisition improvement. Native zoom, tool swap/reload and lifecycle. A5/60 rifle inventory is arranged for reload. Diagnostic white geometry mask counts on-screen weapon triangles, including transparent surfaces; it is not a human visibility, aiming, ergonomics or FPS score. Diagnostic renders occur only in this fixture, never the product.
